999008199.text: 戻ったぞ
……ほう。これはこれは

localizations.en: ...Well now. This is something to behold.

999008199.text:
浴衣って言うんだって。本来はお祭りの時とかに
着る服らしいよ

localizations.en: It's called a yukata. It's traditionally worn at festivals and special occasions.

999008199.text:
お前は私を祭りでもないのに浴衣とやらを着ている
浮かれた人間にしたいのか

localizations.en: So you want to make me look like some carefree tourist wearing festival clothes when there's no festival?

999008199.text:
そういうわけじゃないよ！
ただ単純に、かわいいなあって

localizations.en: That's not it at all! I just thought it looked really cute on you.

999008199.text:
しかしひらひらしていて心許ないな。
少し動きづらくもある。やはりいつもの服のほうが……

localizations.en: It's so loose and flowing though. That makes me feel exposed, plus it's a bit hard to move in. I think my usual outfit suits me better...

999008199.text:
戻すのか？　それは残念だ。
せっかく似合っているというのに

localizations.en: You're going to change back? That's a shame. It suits you so well.

999008199.text: ……そこまで言うならこのままの服にするが

localizations.en: ...If you insist on it, I'll keep it on.

999008199.text:
ほら！　アンペルも似合うって！
あたしの目に間違いはなかったみたい！

localizations.en: See! Empel thinks it looks great too! My fashion sense is undeniable!

999008199.text: しかしこんなものどこで用意したんだ

localizations.en: Where did you even get this thing?

999008199.text: イザナに聞いたの。あの子も似た服を着てるじゃない？

localizations.en: Izana told me about it. Her outfits are similar in style.

999008199.text:
そう考えると、ランターナにもケイウンの文化が
入ってきていたということか

localizations.en: Come to think of it, that would mean that Keiun's cultural influence has already reached Lantarna.

999008199.text:
昔は無数島群域と交流があった名残なのかもしれんな。
その頃はケイウンも国交を閉じていなかったのだろう

localizations.en: It might be a remnant from when the Infinite Island Chain had active trade relations with the kingdom. Keiun probably hadn't closed its borders back then.

999008199.text:
……！　皆、島が見えて来た。
降りる準備をするぞ

localizations.en: ...! Everyone, I can see the island ahead. Get ready to disembark.

999008199.text:
ここがクロガネ島か。
不思議な構造物が建っているな

localizations.en: So this is Kurogane Island. There are some strange structures here.

999008199.text:
まるで島の入り口のように建っているな。
なんらかの領域を示すものだと推察できるが……

localizations.en: They're built like gateways to the island. I'd guess they mark some kind of territorial boundary...

999008199.text:
それを調べるのもいいけど、まずは人に話を聞きに
行かない？　観光地なんだから誰かしらいるよね

localizations.en: Investigating those sounds interesting, but shouldn't we find someone to talk to first? This is supposed to be a tourist destination, so there should be people around, right?

999008199.text: どうだろうな。不思議に思わないか？

localizations.en: I wonder about that. Don't you find it strange?

999008199.text: え……何が？

その構造物、観光地にしてはまったく手入れされて
いないように汚れている

localizations.en: Those structures are completely weathered and neglected for what's supposed to be a tourist attraction.

999008199.text: それにこの海辺にも人影一人見当たらない

localizations.en: And there isn't a single person to be seen anywhere along this shore.

999008199.text: 確かに……本で見た話と違うような

localizations.en: You're right... This isn't what the book described at all.

999008199.text:
何かが起きたと見て間違いないだろう。
急ぐのは得策ではないということだ

localizations.en: Something has definitely happened here. Rushing in would be unwise.

999008199.text:
付近を調べながら進むとしよう。
手掛かりが残っているかもしれない

localizations.en: Let's proceed carefully and investigate as we go. There might be clues left behind.

999008199.text: う、うん……分かったわ
